method: Per-case rows are generated from the engine at the branch head: the owner of each value at load (resolvePatientTargets), the active fault story (faultPatientTargets), and matched-time replays of the paths in test-support/causalTrajectories.ts on the repaired tree and on the baseline tree. Keyed-response clauses, narrative timing and owner decisions are hand annotations. Times are modeled seconds: compressed simulation steps, not bedside time.
